features.description: Stop treating the opencode harness as a quota pool: map qualified spend to backend, reject unmappable writes/CLI selections, remove historical harness cache rows and fold journal backends, with guarded capacity preservation and the dead shell alternation removed.
acceptance_criteria: D1: QuotaBucketFor returns backend for case-insensitive opencode:<backend> and opencode/<backend> beginning with anthropic/codex/ollama/openrouter; bare or unsupported-backend opencode returns "opencode is a harness, not a quota bucket; record the backend bucket instead"; every non-opencode raw value is unchanged. One named four-bucket list is reused by the checks/mapping and mirrored by the shell alternation.

D2: AppendSpend maps qualified opencode spend before journal writes, and unmappable harness values return the diagnostic without creating/changing the journal. Existing chains_post stderr-and-continue behavior is reused without editing that file.

D3: rebuild drops all cached opencode harness rows, maps qualified journal entries under backend, skips unmappable ones and increments existing skipped count. No other cached-row pruning; preserve real bucket rows, capacity and provider-reset fields.

D4: --bucket opencode and every qualified/case variant, even mappable harness values, fail with the same harness diagnostic before reporting. Help retains the four advertised buckets; TestMissionQuotaAdvertisedBucketsAreAllSelectable and its historical opencode comment remain unchanged and green.

D5-D6: admission uses the named four-bucket list and rejects directly constructed Transport opencode with unsupported quota bucket; preserve earlier codex/ollama switch arms and anthropic/openrouter behavior. Only remove |opencode from lane-probe.sh awk alternation; bash 3.2/BSD awk compatibility retained, no other driver edits.

D7 helper table covers opencode/OpenCode errors, opencode:openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3 -> openrouter, opencode/ollama/glm-5.3:cloud -> ollama, opencode:anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5 -> anthropic, opencode:openai/gpt-5.5 error, anthropic/codex/unlabeled unchanged; qualified case and codex coverage included.

D7 ledger arms in separate t.TempDir homes: (a) generated M1 cache keeps anthropic 5h/long and capacity-only zero-token row, removes opencode zero-token/zero-window rows; (b) bare opencode journal skipped exactly once, no harness row; (c) opencode:openrouter/x 7 tokens yields backend 5h/long 7 each; (d) bare AppendSpend errors, absent journal stays absent or pre-existing SHA unchanged; (e) opencode:ollama/m:cloud 3 tokens journals ollama. Fixed live-window time, no real ~/.ailang reads/writes.

D7 CLI arms assert bare/qualified/case harness diagnostics and M1-generated text report has no opencode substring. Neutralize credentials, CODEX_HOME and executable PATH using existing test patterns. Inject admission observers to reach ledger branch without provider probes.

Mutation evidence: baseline/restored green and each intended assertion red under bare helper returning opencode,nil; missing slash mapping; no cache drop (a); fold unmappable (b); skip mapped (c); write before helper (d); no CLI check; revert both D3 halves for text; restore opencode acceptance for admission. Independent capacity-survives assertion in (a) stays GREEN under D3 mutations and turns RED when every zero-token cache row is dropped: over-pruning guard. No new shell arm; unchanged env-i suites remain green because opencode alternation is dead per M6.
